soldier: Soldier head pale yellow, mandibles dark brown, the thorax also pale yellow and the abdomen still paler, the whole body sparsely bearing short hairs. The head capsule is rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin rather straight, the frontal ridge raised upwards. The labrum is bluntly spear-shaped, the semi-transparent region at its apex narrow and roundly projecting, the two apical hairs prominent, the lateral-apical hairs absent. The mandibles are relatively short and stout, their length mostly not exceeding the head width, the inner margin of the apex strongly curved, the vertex of the outer margin higher than the apical point. The lacinia of the maxilla bears ten marginal hairs. Antennae with 15–16 segments, a few individuals with 17, segment 3 the shortest. The postmentum is slender and long, its greatest width more than three times its narrowest, the whole of it exposed beyond the lower margin of the head in lateral view. The middle region of the pronotum bears more than thirty hairs.
